input: Lack of capability or robustness is a risk associated with An incident management system utilizing AI is designed to optimize technician deployment, aiming to efficiently allocate resources and respond to issues in the field. The system seeks to automate decision-making processes, streamlining the deployment of technicians to address problems. It also intends to provide real-time monitoring and control, enabling adjustments to be made as needed.
